name: Structured Outputs and Workflows
outcome: Build a workflow using validated, structured model outputs.
description: Build a small multi-step AI application that produces structured results. Define schemas, validate responses, handle invalid outputs and keep deterministic processing separate from model calls.
external: Basic Python, JSON and software testing.
learn: Define a schema for model-generated data
Validate outputs and handle invalid responses
Compose a bounded workflow with deterministic steps
moduleDescriptions: Define a typed response schema for a scientific extraction task.
Parse and validate outputs; reject or repair invalid responses.
Combine model calls with deterministic processing in a bounded workflow.
Test malformed input, failure handling and repeatable outputs.
prerequisiteRationale: A01 supplies model request and response handling before schema validation and workflow composition.
